properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 5 at 1:31PM EDT until August 5 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Okeechobee...

* Until 230 PM EDT.

* At 131 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Pahokee, moving northwest at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Canal Point, Liberty Point, Pahokee, Clewiston, Buckhead Ridge,
Lake Harbor, and Calusa.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.
